entries.text:
THE FIELD TRIP IS TO
AN AMUSEMENT PARK!
IT'S BEEN AGES. I'LL
ENJOY EVERY BIT!

HEY! GLAD THE
WEATHER CLEARED UP.

MORNING, BATSU.
WHERE'S EVERYONE?

HM? OH, SOMEWHERE
AROUND HERE, I
GUESS.

GOOD MORNING! I'M
EXCITED ABOUT
TODAY'S TRIP!

MORNING, HINATA.
YOU'RE EVEN LIVELIER
THAN USUAL.

OF COURSE! IT'S AN
AMUSEMENT PARK! I'M
RIDING EVERY RIDE!

HINATA, DON'T GET
CARRIED AWAY AND
CAUSE TROUBLE, ALL
RIGHT?

HAHA. SOUNDS LIKE
YOU HAVE YOUR HANDS
FULL, KYOSUKE.

WELL, SUCH IS THE
FATE OF A CLASS
REPRESENTATIVE.

HEY! DON'T JUST
ASSUME I'LL CAUSE
TROUBLE!

HINATA'S READY TO
GO! WHICH ATTRACTION
FIRST?

UM, I WANT TO SEE
THE BIGGEST FERRIS
WHEEL IN JAPAN.

THE FERRIS WHEEL?
SURE, WHY NOT. WHAT
ABOUT YOU?

HMM... WHAT SHOULD I
DO?

NOT SURE? WE'LL BE
AT THE FERRIS WHEEL.
COME ALONG LATER!
GOOD IDEA. I WILL.
SEE YOU LATER!

OH! WHAT ARE YOU
DOING HERE?

HEY, RAN. HUNTING
FOR A SCOOP EVEN WAY
OUT HERE?

WHAT DO YOU MEAN?
PLACES LIKE THIS ARE
PERFECT FOR FINDING
SCOOPS!

YOU LOOK BORED. IF
YOU'RE FREE, WILL
YOU HELP WITH MY
REPORTING?

HMM. HELPING RAN
WITH HER REPORTING
COULD BE FUN...

HELP RAN
DECLINE

I'VE NO PLANS. SURE,
I'LL HELP.

REALLY? GREAT! COME
ALONG, THEN!

SORRY, RAN. THERE'S
SOMEWHERE I WANT TO
GO. MAYBE ANOTHER
TIME.

WHAT?! HONESTLY,
YOU'RE NO FUN!

SORRY! IF I FIND A
GOOD STORY, YOU'LL
BE THE FIRST TO
KNOW.

REALLY? OK, I'LL LET
YOU OFF. SEE YOU!

PHEW, THAT WAS
CLOSE. I DON'T WANT
TO GET ON RAN'S BAD
SIDE.

WHERE TO NOW? WE'RE
AT AN AMUSEMENT
PARK. BETTER ENJOY
IT!

FERRIS WHEEL COASTER
HAUNTED HOUSE ARCADE
TAKE A WALK

I HEARD THIS FERRIS
WHEEL IS ONE OF THE
WORLD'S BIGGEST.
I'LL TAKE A LOOK!

AN AMUSEMENT PARK
MEANS ROLLER
COASTERS! LET'S GO!

A HAUNTED HOUSE
ALONE SOUNDS LONELY.
ANYONE AROUND...?

COMING ALL THIS WAY
JUST TO PLAY ARCADE
GAMES... OH WELL.

I'LL START WITH A
LITTLE WALK AROUND.

FIRST, WE NEED A
DESTINATION. WHERE
COULD WE FIND A GOOD
STORY?
LET'S SEE...

WORLD-CLASS WHEEL?
ROLLER COASTER?
HOW ABOUT THE POND?

HOW ABOUT THE FERRIS
WHEEL? I HEAR IT'S
ONE OF THE WORLD'S
BIGGEST.

THE FERRIS WHEEL? A
BIT TAME, BUT BEING
ONE OF THE WORLD'S
BIGGEST IS A PLUS.

OK! LET'S START
THERE!

THIS IS THAT
SUPPOSEDLY
WORLD-CLASS FERRIS
WHEEL.

BUT I'M NOT SURE IT
REALLY IS ONE OF THE
WORLD'S BIGGEST.

WHY NOT RIDE IT?
THEN YOU CAN GET A
PROPER FEEL FOR ITS
SIZE.

GOOD POINT. LET'S
GO!
HOW WAS IT, RAN?

YES, THAT WAS QUITE
A VIEW. AS A STORY,
IT WAS ALL RIGHT, I
SUPPOSE.

A TOUGH CRITIC!
STILL, I'M GLAD I
COULD HELP.

LET'S TAKE A FEW
PHOTOS, THEN HEAD
BACK!

(WE CHATTED HAPPILY
WHILE I HELPED RAN
TAKE HER
PHOTOGRAPHS.)

IT HAS TO BE THE
ROLLER COASTER.
NOTHING BEATS IT FOR
THRILLS AND A STORY.

THAT'S IT! COME WITH
ME!

NICE! VERY NICE!
THIS LOOKS GREAT!

RAN, THIS SIGN
EXPLAINS THE
COASTER.

LET'S SEE... WHAT'S
IT SAY?

ROLLER COASTER:
BEAGLE. THIS PARK'S
FIRST COASTER WITH A
SIDEWAYS LOOP.

EVEN THE TOUGHEST
RIDER WILL FORGET TO
SCREAM AT ITS
INCREDIBLE SPEED.

...IT SAYS. SOUNDS
PRETTY WILD.

SOUNDS ALMOST TOO
GOOD. IS ANY OF THAT
REALLY TRUE?

WE NEED A SPECIAL
CORRESPONDENT TO
RIDE IT AND GIVE US
A REPORT!

...WHO WOULD THAT
BE?

WHAT DO YOU MEAN?
YOU'RE THE ONE FOR
THE JOB!
W-WHY ME?!

LOOKS LIKE TRUTH IN
ADVERTISING! GIVE ME
ALL THE DETAILS.
WHAT A GREAT STORY!

(RAN LOOKS PLEASED.
WELL, GOOD FOR
HER... THAT WAS A
ROUGH RIDE!)

I THINK WE COULD TRY
A MORE UNEXPECTED
SPOT...

HMM. AND WHERE WOULD
THAT BE?

THE POND! BIG THINGS
CAN HAPPEN IN
ORDINARY PLACES.
TRUST ME, RAN!

WHAT ARE YOU TALKING
ABOUT? BUT YOU SOUND
AWFULLY CONFIDENT.
LET'S GO!

SO WHERE'S THIS
INCIDENT OF YOURS?

A COUPLE, A FAMILY
PICNIC... SO
PEACEFUL. WHERE'S
THIS INCIDENT?

UM... THAT'S
STRANGE...

YOU WASTED MY
PRECIOUS REPORTING
TIME! HOW WILL YOU
MAKE IT UP TO ME?!

(I SPENT THE REST OF
THE DAY BEING
DRAGGED AROUND BY
RAN...)

HEY, IT'S BATSU AND
THE OTHERS. HEY!

HEY! LOOK AT THIS
LINE.

I NEVER THOUGHT I'D
HAVE TO WAIT THIS
LONG FOR A FERRIS
WHEEL.

IT LOOKS NEW. NO
WONDER IT'S POPULAR.

PLUS, CALLING IT ONE
OF THE WORLD'S
BIGGEST DRAWS MORE
PEOPLE, I SUPPOSE.

EVEN SO, THIS IS
RIDICULOUS...

DAMN IT! THAT GUY
JUST CUT INTO THE
LINE!
H-HEY, BATSU!

STOP BATSU
BACK BATSU UP

BATSU, CALM DOWN! A
FIGHT HERE WOULD BE
TROUBLE!

HE BROKE THE RULES,
BUT A FIGHT WOULD
BOTHER EVERYONE.
DON'T HIT HIM.

EXACTLY. BESIDES,
IT'S ALMOST OUR
TURN. LET'S BE
PATIENT.
...TCH. ALL RIGHT.

THE VIEW FROM THE
FERRIS WHEEL WAS
AMAZING!

YES, IT DESERVES TO
BE CALLED ONE OF THE
WORLD'S BIGGEST.

YAWN... GREAT VIEW,
BUT THAT THING MOVES
SO SLOWLY IT PUT ME
TO SLEEP.

IT'S A FERRIS WHEEL,
NOT A SCREAMING
THRILL RIDE. WHAT
DID YOU EXPECT?

(WE HEADED HOME,
CHATTING HAPPILY
TOGETHER.)

I'LL BACK YOU UP! I
WAS GETTING FED UP,
TOO!

HEY, YOU! CAN'T YOU
ACT YOUR AGE AND
WAIT YOUR TURN?

I KNEW IT WOULD TURN
OUT THIS WAY, BUT
STILL...

WE NEVER GOT TO RIDE
THE FERRIS WHEEL! WE
WAITED SO LONG, AND
I WAS SO EXCITED!
SORRY. I JUST...

COME ON, HINATA. AT
LEAST WE GOT THAT
OUT OF OUR SYSTEMS!

IT WASN'T GOOD AT
ALL! YOU HAVEN'T
REFLECTED ON IT ONE
BIT!

BATSU, WHY NOT MAKE
IT UP TO HER WITH A
CAKE SOMETIME?

YES. YOU OWE US AT
LEAST THAT MUCH!

(BATSU AND I ENDED
UP BEING THOROUGHLY
SCOLDED BY HINATA
AND KYOSUKE...)

OH? AREN'T THOSE
THREE IN THE QUEUE
AKIRA AND HER RATHER
NOISY FRIENDS?

NOISY? SO WHAT IF
WE'RE NOISY?

EDGE, DON'T THREATEN
PEOPLE YOU KNOW!

HEY, IT'S OUR TURN.
YOU CAME TO RIDE,
DIDN'T YOU? LET'S
GO.

WAIT, AKIRA. ARE YOU
REALLY KEEPING YOUR
HELMET ON?

OF COURSE. WHY WOULD
I TAKE IT OFF?

BECAUSE THE
ATTENDANT IS
DEFINITELY GOING TO
STOP YOU!

REMOVE HER HELMET
LEAVE IT ON

(DESPITE AKIRA'S
PROTESTS, I MADE HER
TAKE HER HELMET
OFF.)

W-WHAT ARE YOU
DOING?! S-STOP!

THERE. I'LL LOOK
AFTER YOUR HELMET
FOR NOW.

PLEASE! GIVE IT
BACK!

WOW! WHAT A COASTER!
EVEN I WAS YELLING A
LITTLE!

...HM? WHAT'S WRONG,
AKIRA?

...HOW AWFUL. I'M
SCARED OF COASTERS.
THAT'S WHY I WANTED
MY HELMET...

HONESTLY! THAT WAS A
TERRIBLE THING TO DO
TO HER.

S-SORRY! BUT THE
THRILLS WERE LIKE
RIDING A MOTORCYCLE.
FUN, RIGHT?

(IT TOOK QUITE A
WHILE TO SOOTHE
AKIRA, WHO LOOKED
CLOSE TO TEARS...)

WELL, IF AKIRA
REALLY DOESN'T WANT
TO TAKE IT OFF, WE
CAN'T FORCE HER.

SORRY. I ABSOLUTELY
CAN'T TAKE IT OFF
HERE.

NO GOOD, HUH... TCH.
WHAT AN INFLEXIBLE
ATTENDANT.

SORRY, EVERYONE. I'M
SCARED OF COASTERS.
I CAN'T RIDE WITHOUT
MY HELMET.

WELL, IT CAN'T BE
HELPED. THERE'S MORE
TO AN AMUSEMENT PARK
THAN COASTERS!

THEN GET RIDES I CAN
FIT ON! I CAN'T RIDE
MOST OF THESE. IT'S
BORING!

HMM... THAT MIGHT BE
THE TOUGHEST REQUEST
OF ALL...
HEH! YOU SAID IT.

HEEHEE! YOU'RE ALL
SO SELFISH!

(WE NEVER RODE THE
COASTER, BUT WE
STILL HAD A GOOD
TIME TOGETHER.)

(MAYBE IT WORKED OUT
BETTER THIS WAY.)

HERE I AM AT THE
HAUNTED HOUSE. GOING
IN ALONE SEEMS DULL.
WHAT SHOULD I DO?
OH? ISN'T THAT YOU?

IT IS! WHAT ARE YOU
DOING HERE?

DECIDING WHETHER TO
GO IN. THESE PLACES
AREN'T MUCH FUN
ALONE, ARE THEY?

YOU SAY THAT, BUT
YOU'RE REALLY
FRIGHTENED, AREN'T
YOU?
N-NO! THAT'S NOT IT!

HAHA! JUST A JOKE.
WE WERE ABOUT TO GO
IN. CARE TO JOIN US?

JOIN ROY AND FRIENDS
GIVE IT A MISS

SURE! WITH BOMAN
ALONG, AT LEAST THE
GHOSTS WON'T SCARE
ME.

IT'S TOO DARK TO SEE
ANYTHING.

OH, GREAT. I CAN'T
EVEN TELL WHICH WAY
THE EXIT IS.

EEK! WHO TOUCHED MY
BOTTOM?!

IT WASN'T ME! OW!
STOP HITTING ME!

UGH... THAT WAS
AWFUL.

STRANGE. WHAT
HAPPENED INSIDE WAS
MORE FUN THAN THE
HAUNTED HOUSE.

WE ENJOYED OURSELVES
IN THE END. THAT'S
WHAT MATTERS, ISN'T
IT?
JUST AS BOMAN SAYS!

(TIFFANY'S HURRICANE
BATTERED ME INSIDE,
BUT EVERYONE SEEMED
HAPPY.)

...MAYBE I'LL PASS.
IT LOOKS A LITTLE
SCARY.
YOU HAVE NO GUT!

YOU MEAN GUTS. ARE
YOU REALLY NOT
COMING?

SORRY, BUT I'LL PASS
THIS TIME.

I SEE... WE'LL SEE
YOU LATER, THEN.

(I'D LOOK PATHETIC
IF I SCREAMED IN
FRONT OF EVERYONE.
BETTER SKIP IT.)

HEY! YOU CAME HERE,
TOO?

HI, EVERYONE. HAVING
FUN?

MORE OR LESS. I
THINK ROBERTO IS
ENJOYING HIMSELF
MOST.

YEAH. SORRY FOR
DRAGGING YOU ALONG.

SINCE WE'RE ALL
HERE, WHY DON'T WE
PLAY A GAME
TOGETHER?
GOOD IDEA...

LET'S PLAY HERE!
GO SOMEWHERE ELSE

SOUNDS GOOD! WHICH
GAME SHALL WE
COMPETE AT?

FOR A GROUP, A BIG
MACHINE IS BEST. HOW
ABOUT THIS ONE?

HEY, THAT LOOKS FUN!
I DON'T KNOW WHAT IT
IS, THOUGH.

I DON'T KNOW MUCH
ABOUT GAMES, SO I'LL
LEAVE IT TO YOU.

WOW, THAT WAS FUN!
ROBERTO, YOU'RE
REALLY GOOD AT
THESE!

YES. HOW DO YOU
MANAGE TO BE SO
GOOD? IT'S A
MYSTERY.

HAHA! PRACTICE.
RIGHT?

THAT'S TRUE. IT DOES
GET EXPENSIVE,
THOUGH.

(WE CARRIED ON
ENJOYING THE ARCADE
TOGETHER.)

WE CAME TO THE PARK.
SHOULD WE TRY
SOMETHING WE CAN
ONLY DO HERE?

TRUE, BUT... WHAT
WOULD EVERYONE LIKE
TO DO?

HMM. I'D LIKE TO
RIDE THE FERRIS
WHEEL.

WHAT? AT AN
AMUSEMENT PARK, IT
HAS TO BE THE ROLLER
COASTER!

(NOBODY WANTS TO GO
TO THE SAME
PLACE...)

(AT THIS RATE, IT'LL
BE TIME TO GO HOME
BEFORE WE DECIDE.)

(THAT'S HYO, THE
STUDENT COUNCIL
PRESIDENT... I'LL
TRY TALKING TO HIM.)

HYO, ARE YOU HERE
ALONE?

...HM? AS YOU CAN
SEE.

IF YOU DON'T MIND...
WOULD YOU LIKE TO
LOOK AROUND WITH ME?

VERY WELL. I HAVE
NOTHING IN
PARTICULAR TO DO
ANYWAY.
WELL, THEN...

TRY AN ATTRACTION
RELAX BY THE POND
SHALL WE TRY A RIDE?
AN ATTRACTION?

Y-YES. THE FERRIS
WHEEL OR THE ROLLER
COASTER. THEY'RE
QUITE FUN.

...WELL, ALL RIGHT.
I SHALL ACCOMPANY
YOU.

I HEARD THE ROLLER
COASTER IS A GOOD
CHOICE...

N-NO, ACTUALLY...
HOW ABOUT THE FERRIS
WHEEL?

HOW TIRESOME! DID
YOU BRING ME ALL
THIS WAY TO WASTE MY
TIME?

HYO, PLEASE CALM
DOWN.

SILENCE! I HAVE NO
WISH TO HEAR
ANYTHING MORE FROM
YOU!

(...HE'S GONE.
PERHAPS INVITING HIM
ALONG WAS A
MISTAKE.)

SHALL WE GO
SOMEWHERE QUIET? I
HEAR THERE'S A POND
A SHORT WALK AWAY.

VERY WELL. I WAS
GROWING RATHER TIRED
OF THE CROWDS
MYSELF.

WHAT DO YOU THINK?
IT'S NICE AND QUIET
HERE.

HM. NOT BAD. HERE,
AT LEAST, I NEEDN'T
ENDURE THAT
BOTHERSOME NOISE.

...NATURE IS A FINE
THING.

OPEN YOUR HEART AND
TOUCH NATURE, AND
YOUR PETTY TROUBLES
SEEM TO DISAPPEAR.

...NO. THE TROUBLES
REMAIN. A WEAK HEART
JUST FORGETS AND IS
SOOTHED.

(HYO HAS WORRIES OF
HIS OWN, TOO...)

(AFTER THAT, WE SAID
NOTHING. WE SIMPLY
SHARED A QUIET,
PEACEFUL TIME.)
